title: ZephyrusFactions
description: A custom Factions plugin for ZephyrusNet with territory protection, grace period, upgrades, GUI menu, power system, player head drops, Vault economy, PlaceholderAPI, and LuckPerms chat integration.
body:
# ⚔️ ZephyrusFactions

**ZephyrusFactions** is a lightweight yet feature-rich Factions plugin built for modern Minecraft servers. Create your faction, claim territory, build power, and dominate the server — all with a sleek in-game GUI control panel.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🏰 **Faction System** — Create, disband, and manage factions with full member roles (Owner, Officer, Member)
- 🗺️ **Territory Claiming** — Claim chunks to protect your land from enemies
- ⚡ **Power System** — Gain and lose power through gameplay
- 💰 **Faction Bank** — Deposit and withdraw money into a shared faction treasury
- 📦 **Upgrade System** — Upgrade your faction's chunk limit, max members, power cap, spawn shield, and territory regen
- 🖥️ **GUI Control Panel** — Manage everything in-game through an intuitive chest GUI (no commands needed)
- 👥 **Member Management** — Promote, demote, kick, and transfer ownership directly from the GUI
- ⚙️ **Faction Settings** — Toggle open/invite-only mode, friendly fire, set faction home, and manage ally/enemy relations

---

## 🖥️ GUI Menus

| Menu | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 🏠 Main Panel | Central hub for all faction management |
| ⬆️ Upgrades | Upgrade chunk limit, power, members, shield & regen |
| 👥 Members | View, promote, demote, kick members |
| 💰 Bank | Deposit & withdraw faction funds |
| ⚙️ Settings | Configure faction behavior and relations |

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/f create <name>` | Create a new faction |
| `/f panel` | Open the GUI control panel |
| `/f invite <player>` | Invite a player |
| `/f claim` | Claim the chunk you're standing on |
| `/f home` | Teleport to faction home |
| `/f leave` | Leave your faction |
| `/f disband` | Disband your faction |

---

## ⚠️ Beta Notice

This is an **early beta release**. Features are still being actively developed and bugs may be present. Please report any issues on the project page. Feedback and suggestions are welcome!

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Paper server

---
